legal information

Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how aether art space processes personal data when you use this website, contact us, or start a booking. It also explains the choices and rights available to you.

Last updated: September 10, 2026

Data controller and scope

aether art space, Budapest, Tátra utca 29b. is the controller for personal data processed through this website. You can contact us at photostudio.aether@gmail.com.

This notice applies to studioaether.com, contact requests sent through the website, and bookings started from this website.

Data we process and why

When you contact us, we process the name, email address, and message you provide so we can answer your enquiry. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, or our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries.

When you make a booking, the booking is completed in Cal.com. The information you submit there is used to arrange and manage your appointment and related customer communication. The legal basis is performance of a contract or taking steps at your request before entering into one.

Our web host and security systems may process limited technical information such as IP address, browser and server-log data to deliver the website, prevent abuse, and keep it secure. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in operating a secure website.

Service providers and external links

We use Web3Forms to receive messages submitted through the website contact form and Cal.com to provide online booking. These providers process information under their own privacy terms and may process data outside the European Economic Area using the safeguards described in their documentation.

Links to social-media profiles, Google Maps, and other external websites are governed by the privacy notices of those services. We do not control their data processing.

Cookies and analytics

The website stores a small preference cookie only when you make a cookie choice. It records whether optional analytics and advertising storage is allowed and is kept for up to 180 days.

If Google measurement tags are enabled for the site, they are configured with analytics and advertising storage denied by default. Optional measurement is enabled only after you choose “Accept all” in the cookie notice. You can change this choice at any time using Cookie settings in the footer.

Retention and security

We keep contact and booking-related information only for as long as needed to handle the request, provide the service, resolve a dispute, or meet a legal record-keeping obligation. Technical logs are retained for the period needed for security and operations. Service providers may apply their own retention periods.

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data. No internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Your rights

Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction, deletion, restriction of, or objection to the processing of your personal data. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent at any time. You may also request portability where it applies.

To exercise a right, email photostudio.aether@gmail.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hungarian supervisory authority, the National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH).

Changes to this notice

We may update this notice when our practices or legal obligations change. The latest version will always be published on this page.
